negative_control.measured_by: definer at groom, this host, against the draft candidate measured in the tree

re_premise_not_relax: the 5-count pin becomes a 4-count pin PLUS an exactly-one verified-row pin whose eight fields (artifact=ops/deployment-health.md, url=<the -1qtu health URL>, http_status=200, database=postgresql, fallback_active=false, version=1.0.0, evidence=measured_by_t92_record, record=docs/state/outputs/t92_deploy_evidence.json) must ALL match, PLUS an explicit leg that REDS if LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_STATE ever reappears as a DEFERRED_ROW or on a PASS line. The four surviving DEFERRED_ROW legs, the criteria-number legs and the mutual-exclusion discipline are kept. A register that drops a genuinely-deferred row, bumps the header while the stale row stays, or prints a verified row missing any live field is still RED - each of those is measured in negative_control.matrix.
stale_at_merge_check: before applying, re-read tests[187].command and require sha256(command.encode()) == old_command_sha256 (ca6e31fd950339a798d2bbe7ede50b072ab7df4ac7b88fea275ba099c9ccd4cc). If it differs, the index moved under this amendment: stop, re-derive against the new stored text, never apply blind.
why_this_file_exists: tests[187] (issue_id t41) pins the security_ops deferral register at the literal 'DEFERRAL_REGISTER 5 DEFERRED', at a DEFERRED_ROW count of 5, and at the whole LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_STATE row text including reason=live_render_url_returns_404_measured against the OLD no-suffix host. The live deployment is real: the t92 evidence record and the re-measurement at t93 groom both show https://expense-tracker-dashboard-1qtu.onrender.com/api/v1/health answering 200 with database=postgresql and fallback_active=false, while the OLD host still answers 404. The stored row therefore lists a SATISFIED obligation as deferred - the same class of defect as a fabricated PASS. Moving the row necessarily turns tests[187] RED, so the change needs a FORMAL gate amendment that RE-PREMISES the rule. A relaxed gate is not an option.
written_by_definer_applied_by: the orchestrator, in the strict merge window, after re-checking stale_at_merge_check. The definer and the builder NEVER edit docs/state/merge_test_index.json (orchestrator-owned; card ac5 fences it byte-clean). This record is the instrument the orchestrator applies - exactly the t89/t90 gate-amendment precedent.
